name: AGENTOS_CONTROLLER

role_display.ongoing_rule: Current status and control-plane records identify the persistent role as Intent Regulator; Bootstrap is reserved for first-run discovery and setup.
role_display.history_rule: Older accepted Controller state may omit the display fields and remains readable; newly compiled state always writes them.

storage_rule: Controller state is stored under the bound control-plane root and is never written into the product root by default. An in-project control plane requires an explicit owner opt-in.
purpose: A persistent project-level control plane that validates its own governance and handoffs and may create, start, wake, observe, or dispatch redistribution for exactly one Agent Spawner. Spawner alone owns role compilation, roster mutation, spawn/admission, routing, archival/despawn, invalidation, and rebuild.

controller_agent.wake_rule: Wake on every active campaign handoff, liveness observation, failure finding, policy amendment, or boundary change; ask the owner only when the typed boundary requires an owner decision.

controller_runtime.consequential_transition_rule: No external action is complete until a project-bound adapter performs it and returns a readback bound to the exact project, controller, policy, campaign, event, action, and external identity.
controller_runtime.persistent_state: Compare-and-swap protected state with an append-only event head and readback receipts.

supervisor.loop_rule: Hold one Controller lease, observe exactly one Agent Spawner and current Controller governance records, dispatch typed redistribution without approval, retain exact failures, and never assume Spawner lifecycle authority.
supervisor.hard_boundary_rule: Stop the dependent outcome on protected authority, identity, evidence, credential, destructive, external, or unresolved owner-intent boundaries.
supervisor.soft_boundary_rule: Send changed scope or operating choices to campaign Orchestrator review while unrelated safe work continues.
supervisor.puzzle_rule: Route one repairable engineering puzzle through campaign custody, then require Auditor and Controller rechecks.
supervisor.session_rule: Campaign roles remain observable through durable local sessions, heartbeats, source-bound commands, and readbacks; a protected hold keeps the Controller Runtime alive without activating dependent work.

operating_loop.temporary_role_rule: Agent Spawner alone owns governance compilation, roster admission, seeds, working agents, handoffs, repair intake, invalidation, rebuild, archival, and despawn; Controller only validates its own governance and the Spawner handoff, starts or wakes one Spawner, observes it, and dispatches typed redistribution.
operating_loop.repair_rule: Preserve evidence, classify the finding, record root cause, apply the smallest admitted repair, refresh bindings, replace the predecessor with visible host receipts, and require independent clearance.
operating_loop.naming_rule: Temporary role display names carry the exact version and two-digit test-build tag.

event_authority.adapter_rule: Resolve and validate canonical issuer, current authority epoch, trusted time, nonce, sequence, replay head, state, custody, and global policy before any adapter invocation.

campaign_boundary.import_orchestrator_rule: Any Orchestrator is admitted, routed, observed, and archived only by Agent Spawner. Controller has no Orchestrator, roster, seed, working-agent, handoff-approval, invalidation, or archival authority.
campaign_boundary.successor_rule: Orient the next Campaign Orchestrator only after Auditor release clearance; do not start the next campaign before accepted-live closure.

external_adapters.rule: Model, session, worktree, repository, provider, deployment, rollback, live-audit, and browser capabilities enter through typed project-bound adapters.

architecture_repair_gate.rule: An architecture repair candidate is admissible only when its acceptance contract is the digest of a validated shared-plus-generated architecture envelope bound to the same source and Bootstrap plan.
